name: text-sticky-shrink
title: Sticky Shrinking Headline
description: Tiêu đề rất to chiếm cả trang thu nhỏ dần về góc trên bên trái và nằm gọn trong thanh đầu trang khi nội dung cuộn lên.

moworks.author: takayu

options.maxWidth: px it may span in the header (800)
options.inset: [x, y] px of its spot in the header ([60, 30])
options.rows: the page rows that scroll up

moworks.notes: Idea and numbers (TakayuStudio tx-sticky-shrink-headline, written here): Page frame 292 × 168 px (radius 6) with a 24 px header bar (three small pills on its right). Headline 110 px, left-aligned, up to 2 lines. Over 0.4–1.8 s (cubic-bezier .65,0,.35,1) it scales 1 → the size that fits the header (≈0.15, ≤160 px wide) with origin top-left, while its top-left moves to the header's inset (12, 6 px); a dashed slot outline fades in there; placeholder rows scroll up 90 px. Return 2.9–3.5 s. Loop 3.8 s. Params: tỉ lệ cuối (0.15) · thời gian (1.4 s) · gốc (trên trái).
